_about: General terms used on many pages. Owner: supervisor / foundation. Other writers: reuse these ids; do not redefine them in your own file.

accelerator.short: A chip that does AI math much faster than a CPU. In DeepInfer, an accelerator is an NVIDIA GPU or a Huawei Ascend NPU.

gpu.short: Graphics Processing Unit. A chip with thousands of small cores that do the same operation on many values at the same time.
gpu.long: DeepInfer supports NVIDIA SM100 GPUs ({{cite README.md:35}}). On this site, "GPU" means an NVIDIA GPU unless the text says otherwise.

npu.short: Neural Processing Unit. Huawei's name for its Ascend AI chips. In DeepInfer, an NPU does the same work as a GPU.
npu.long: DeepInfer supports Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs ({{cite README.md:36}}).

kernel.short: A small program that runs on the GPU or NPU. One kernel does one operation, for example a matrix multiply, on many values in parallel.

tensor.short: A multi-dimensional array of numbers, for example a vector or a matrix. A PyTorch tensor is in CPU memory or in GPU/NPU memory.

dtype.short: The number format of a tensor, for example bfloat16, float8 or int32. It sets how many bytes each value uses.

fp8.short: An 8-bit floating-point number format. It uses half the memory of BF16. It needs scale factors to keep enough precision.

moe.short: Mixture of Experts. A layer with many small feed-forward networks (experts). A router sends each token to only a few of them.

expert-parallelism.short: EP. The experts of an MoE layer are split across devices. Tokens go to the devices that hold their experts, and the results come back.

data-parallelism.short: DP. Several devices run the same model part, and each device works on different requests.

rank.short: The number of one process in a distributed job. In DeepInfer, one rank normally drives one GPU or NPU.

process-group.short: A set of ranks that communicate through torch.distributed. Each group uses one backend, for example NCCL, HCCL or Gloo.

collective.short: A communication step in which all ranks of a group take part, for example all-reduce, all-gather or all-to-all.

environment-variable.short: A named text value that a process gets when it starts, for example CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1. DeepInfer reads many settings this way.

extension-module.short: A compiled library (a .so file) that Python imports like a normal module. deepinfer._C is DeepInfer's C++ extension module.

pybind11.short: A C++ library that makes C++ functions and classes callable from Python. DeepInfer uses it to build deepinfer._C.

vendor-library.short: An external kernel library in vendor/ (FlashMLA, DeepGEMM, DeepEP, DeepSelect). It is a git submodule. This site explains only how DeepInfer calls it.
